name: Braided frontiers
summary: Deep homes, scattered deep expansions, medium shelves and secondary pockets, shallow approaches, a modest center.
rules: Three layers form the background and central four squares.
Keep the starting 2×2 homes at five layers.
Place six deep wells in a staggered expansion on one wing.
Place ten four-layer wells across a compact shelf and small secondary pockets on the other wing.
Place ten shallow wells along approaches and one exposed edge square.
Rotate every feature 180° for the other player.
